caption: The drawing depicts a small, square wooden side table rendered in shades of reddish-brown, with a single drawer at the front featuring a round brass or gold-colored knob. The table has a flat top with slightly beveled edges, supported by four straight, narrow legs. There is an H-shaped support structure connecting the legs at the lower part of the table, close to the floor. The object is centered within a rectangular border on a plain beige or off-white background. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, outside the border, the name "Francis Law Durand" is written in small, uppercase letters. No additional objects or patterns are present in the drawing.
title: Table (Occasional)
